title: Cohort-gated roadmap timelines and initiative traceability for Private instances
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise customers require predictable, low-risk Private/VPC/on‑prem rollouts with clear dependencies and measurable progress across quarters. We need a repeatable quarterly planning framework that gates feature tranches by customer cohort readiness (compatibility, legal, infra), surfaces initiative traceability to OKRs, and provides deterministic acceptance criteria for each tranche. This ticket defines the roadmap timelines, gating rules, traceability matrix, and rollout checkpoints for Q2 deliverables for Private instances.
background: Over the past 9 months we observed installs failing late in the funnel due to mismatched networking expectations, KMS onboarding, and third‑party driver compatibility. Sales and CSMs report friction for mid‑market customers who require explicit upgrade windows. Existing roadmap artifacts are siloed across Confluence pages and PRs; we need a single source of truth that ties initiatives to OKRs and release gates.
objectives: Define cohort gating criteria for Private/VPC/on‑prem features (pilot, early adopter, GA)
Create an initiative-to-OKR traceability matrix scoped to Q2 features
Establish deterministic acceptance criteria and SLOs for each tranche
Deliver a rollout calendar with cutover windows and rollback playbooks
success_metrics: Reduce customer install failure rate for Private by 60% within 90 days of GA
Time-to-first-successful-onboarding for new Private customers <= 7 days
90% of Q2 tranche features have traceability to at least one OKR and owner
No critical security findings post‑GA for features released under this framework
scope_in: Traceability matrix linking initiatives -> owners -> OKRs
Per-tranche acceptance criteria (installer, KMS, RBAC, upgrade path)
Pre-release checklist for security and compliance signoff
scope_out: Major rearchitecture of runtime (will be separate initiative)
Changes to hosted API pricing model
Customer-specific bespoke deployment engineering (handled as paid services)

rollout_strategy: Cohort 0 (Internal): full install/upgrade validation in staging clusters
Cohort 1 (Pilot EA): 3 existing customers known to CSM and engineering
Cohort 2 (Early Adopter): up to 10 customers who opt into GA candidate
Cohort 3 (GA): broader availability with standard install docs and long-term support
Each tranche requires explicit signoff from Security, Support, and Release Engineering
acceptance_criteria: Installer must complete unattended install in lab infra with documented kernel/driver matrix
Network bootstrap must work with customer-provided NAT and restrictive firewall rules
KMS integration tested end-to-end with at least one HSM back end and one cloud KMS
Upgrade path validated from last 2 released private versions with automated smoke tests
Observability hooks (trace + token-level cost breakdown) present and ingesting data into Console dev cluster
tasks: PM: Draft gating rules and publish Confluence doc (link below)
Infra Eng: Create lab infra configurations for 3 kernel/driver combos

risks_mitigation: Risk: Late discovery of incompatible NIC drivers. Mitigation: Expand lab matrix early and enlist partner OEMs for validation
Risk: Security signoff delay. Mitigation: Parallelize with preliminary threat model and pre-review sessions
Risk: Customer scheduling for pilot windows. Mitigation: Offer two consecutive windows and provide dedicated SRE during pilot
